The next page puts the vision model beside the text model, part by part; the Try it box before it runs this model on any photo you choose. Honest note: two photos of people standing in a row are a tiny dataset. The model learns them well and does less well on what it never saw — the section “Building a bigger dataset” shows how the
labels of real projects are made and grown, technique by technique.
